from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,sys,shlex
state=Path(__file__).parent
out=state/'3323-compile-probe'
repo=Path('/Users/lexoliu/Coding/cherenkov-benchmarks')
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'scripts'))
from sync_runs import RunArchive,publish
def adb(*args):
 if args[0]=='shell':args=('shell',shlex.join(args[1:]))
 return subprocess.check_output(['adb','-s','100.76.86.48:5555',*args],timeout=30).decode().strip()
revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
metadata={'device':{'model':adb('shell','getprop','ro.product.model'),'model_identifier':adb('shell','getprop','ro.product.device'),'os':'Android '+adb('shell','getprop','ro.build.version.release'),'gpu':'Mali-G715'},'source':{'revision':revision},'configuration':{'measurement_kind':'standalone-vulkan-compile-diagnostic','cache':'No explicit pipeline cache, fresh process for each pipeline; OS driver cache untouched','variant':'Original SPIR-V versus every OpLoopMerge marked DontUnroll; identical formulas'}}
journal=RunArchive(out/'journal',metadata)
remote='/data/local/tmp/cherenkov-3323-compile-probe'
adb('shell','mkdir','-p',remote)
try:
 adb('push',str(state/'3323-graphics-probe'),remote+'/probe')
 adb('shell','chmod','700',remote+'/probe')
 for path in out.glob('*.spv'):adb('push',str(path),remote+'/'+path.name)
 rows=[]
 for engine in ['engine2','engine4']:
  for index,arm in enumerate(['default','dont-unroll','dont-unroll','default']):
   result=json.loads(adb('shell',remote+'/probe',remote+'/'+engine+'-'+arm+'.spv'))
   row={'module':engine,'arm':arm,'round':index,**result};rows.append(row)
   path=out/f'{engine}-{index}.json'
   path.write_text(json.dumps({'engine':'cherenkov','scene':'pipeline-compile-'+engine,'width':None,'height':None,'samples':[],'diagnostic':row,'probe_source':(state/'3323-graphics-probe.c').read_text(),'runner_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}))
   journal.record(path,{},valid=False,reason='Standalone driver compilation diagnostic, not rendering or frame timing; no GPU-clock control.')
   print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
 (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
finally:
 adb('shell','rm','-rf',remote)
 if (out/'journal').exists():publish(journal.directory,repo)
